title: Zeus native messaging protocol v1
description: Messages exchanged between the browser extension and the daemon (through zeus-native-host). Normative text: docs/spec/02-native-messaging-v1.md. Receivers MUST ignore unknown properties.

InterruptReason.description: chrome.downloads.InterruptReason (verified 2026-10-05) plus UNKNOWN for values an implementation cannot map.

v.description: Protocol major version of this message. hello is always sent with v=1.

re.description: id of the request this message answers.

profile_id.description: Random value created once per browser profile and kept in extension storage. Routes browser-bound jobs to the right cookie jar.

filename.description: Basename only. Absolute paths MUST NOT leave the browser.

approval.description: The full approval with its facts (07 section 4.8).

request_hash.description: The hash the extension recomputed from the facts it displayed (07 section 4.6).

confirmation.description: How the human confirmed (07 section 7.7); absent means gesture.

KillSwitchBody.description: Engage or release the kill switch from an extension page or notification (07 section 8). Release is refused from extension_notification.
